title: Reading Drill — A Greenhouse with Two Doors
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Greenhouse with Two Doors
passages.body:
**A** A volunteer group noticed that seedlings nearest the greenhouse door grew more slowly. Members first checked light levels and looked for damage from insects, but neither result explained the pattern.

**B** Next they placed simple strips of paper near the two doors. The strips showed a strong draught whenever both doors were open, even on days when the air outside the greenhouse felt still.

**C** To reduce the effect, the group asked visitors to close one door before opening the other. It moved a storage rack so that people carrying heavy trays could follow the new route comfortably.
